title: What is Mistral Large 4? Pricing and Benchmarks
summary: What is Mistral Large 4 is explained through a breakdown of its token costs, performance metrics, and real-world capabilities for enterprise workflows.
body_markdown:
## Frequently asked questions about Mistral Large 4


Mistral Large 4 is a flagship open-weight model that provides the high-reasoning capabilities necessary for complex enterprise workflows without the rigid constraints of closed-source licensing.


This architecture allows you to audit the model weights directly, which ensures that your security team can verify the integrity of the system before it touches sensitive production data.


### Is Mistral Large 4 open source?


Mistral Large 4 is an open-weight model, with its weights due to be released at the end of the month.


This distinction allows you to inspect the model's parameters for safety audits. Your security lead can approve the deployment without relying on a black-box vendor.


### How do I access Mistral Large 4 via API?


Access to the model is provided through La Plateforme, Mistral’s official managed API service, or via major cloud providers like Azure AI Studio and[AWS Bedrock](https://www.activepieces.com/pieces/amazon-bedrock) .


Using these managed endpoints removes the need for local hardware maintenance. You can start prototyping immediately using standard REST requests.


Each provider offers different regional availability, which determines where data is processed to meet local residency requirements.


### Does Mistral Large 4 support vision or multimodal inputs?


Mistral Large 4 is a native multimodal model capable of processing both text and image inputs within a single context window.


This functionality allows the model to analyze charts, diagrams, and scanned documents. An automated system can extract structured data from a visual invoice without a separate OCR step.


By unifying these modalities, the model handles tasks that would otherwise require chaining multiple specialized tools together.


### Can I self-host Mistral Large 4 on private infrastructure?


Self-hosting is supported through deployment containers like vLLM or NVIDIA NIM, which allow the model to run on internal GPU clusters.


Hosting internally ensures that all data remains within your corporate firewall. Your legal department can maintain total control over data sovereignty.


### Hardware and VRAM requirements for self-hosting


Running a model with 1.05T parameters requires massive hardware resources that far exceed consumer-grade equipment. Even with the Mixture-of-Experts architecture, loading the full model requires substantial GPU memory well beyond typical consumer-grade hardware.


Standard enterprise setups typically require a cluster of high-end GPUs such as NVIDIA H100 or A100 to achieve acceptable inference speeds. Attempting to run this on a single workstation or basic server will result in out-of-memory errors or unusable latency.


This setup is the primary choice for industries with strict regulatory frameworks that prohibit sending data to third-party API providers.
